title: PB Invoice tracker (compose, English)
describe: Read the PDF invoices in the Nextcloud folder /Invoices-Q3 into a table with invoice date, supplier, invoice number, amount excl. VAT, VAT and total. Build an app with a dashboard: count of invoices, sum of totals, a table of all invoices with a filter on supplier, and a detail screen per invoice.
note: `until` matches the phase KEY or its KIND (drive-playbook.js), so the run stops after the table phase however the model keyed it; read `until <key> (table): stopping here` in the notes to know the cheap gate held. The driver breaks BEFORE the consent patch, so the phase is reported `awaiting` (the server only moves a table phase running → awaiting; `done` is the person's consent) — hence the two accepted statuses, as in 07. The judge evaluates expect.compose on the composed document and expect.phases.table on the phase (falls back to the kind).
